GRAIN BANK RATES:
Corn: Effective 10/1/21 – 6 cents bushel/month Pro-rated daily. Exclusively for feed customers. Additional Charges may apply. Call for details.
Beans: Effective 9/22/21 – We will no longer accept beans for grain bank.
Grain Marketing
Grain marketing is critical to your farming operation’s success. Centerra Co-op's full-service Grain Marketing office can access domestic and export markets to find the best values for your grain. Call us at 800-472-4644 or 419-207-2163.
New One-Weigh Scan System
CENTERRA CO-OP GRAFTON
In June 2025, we implemented a new automated RFID scan system at our Grafton grain facility (same as our Mansfield branch). Drivers will scan their customized keycards to select who they're hauling for, what commodity they're hauling and what they're doing with their load. This new system will save time, keep trucks moving, and eliminate errors. Check out this tutorial to see how easy it is to use, and if you have any questions, give us a call at 419-281-2153.
One-Weigh Scan System
CENTERRA CO-OP MANSFIELD
We are now using a new automated RFID scan system at our Mansfield grain facility. Drivers will scan their customized keycards to select who they're hauling for, what commodity they're hauling and what they're doing with their load.
